checkpoint_invariant_evidence.condition: The ep29 architecture signature exactly matches module names, tensor dimensions, value classes, precision, timestep count, rank mode, and interface parameters used by the sealed RTL/TB.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.retained_claim: Protocol ordering, ready/valid/backpressure behavior, reset behavior, arithmetic unit contract, and directed or mapped-VCS functional evidence for the same RTL/netlist.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.not_retained: Any ep35/ep24 real-trace hit rate, cycle count, sparsity, toggle activity, or speedup.

checkpoint_invariant_evidence.condition: Exact RTL, parameters, SDC, target libraries, macro interfaces, and synthesis constraints are unchanged after the ep29 architecture signature gate.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.retained_claim: Logic area, setup/hold status, clock target, formal equivalence, and static macro geometry/port implementation.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.not_retained: SAIF-driven dynamic power, energy per frame, effective throughput, or paper-PPA-ready system claims.

checkpoint_invariant_evidence.condition: Layer shapes, encoded element widths, maximum descriptor format, banking, address widths, Acc24 policy, T10, and rank/value-class identities match exactly.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.retained_claim: Provisioned bytes, bank count, port count, address legality, maximum structural capacity, and arbitration protocol.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.not_retained: Observed occupancy, compressed working-set fit, refill rate, parent/PWP residency, or conflict probability; those depend on ep29 values and activity.

checkpoint_invariant_evidence.condition: The cited paper/artifact version and comparison definition are unchanged.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.retained_claim: Published Prosperity/Phi/FireFly-T/CICC metrics, citations, baseline taxonomy, and the frozen comparison methodology.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.not_retained: Official-artifact replay numbers mapped onto H67/ep35 or ep24 tensors; these must be replayed on ep29 and remain external-baseline results, never ours.

checkpoint_invariant_evidence.condition: The proof assumptions and structural parameters are present verbatim in the ep29 identity manifest.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.retained_claim: Fail-closed protocol invariants and architecture-level impossibility or legality results.
checkpoint_invariant_evidence.not_retained: Data-distribution negative or positive results, including empty-tile rate, delta density, product reuse, and Amdahl fractions.

predeclared final-selection receipt rather than file-presence inference
config, model-source commit, dataset-list and preprocessing hashes
strict load with missing=0 and unexpected=0
topology, precision, rank, timestep and value-class signature
standard valid825 AEE/AAE
dyadic/quantized valid825
hardware-order RTL-exact valid825
spike/activity totals and any accuracy delta
mandatory_ep29_replays.reason: Training loss is neither AEE nor deployment accuracy.

predeclared ten-sample C1 cohort
predeclared three-sequence by ten-sample decoder cohort
four bottleneck Conv inputs/weights/parent identities
decoder D0-D3 activations and D1 theta/numeric side data
ATLIF, FC1, FC2, patch-embed, BN, Q/K/V and attention taps
mandatory_ep29_replays.reason: One checkpoint load and one instrumentation path prevents per-operator identity drift.

zero, bit, product and executable single-port parent-capture cycles
parent/PWP occupancy, 1RW conflicts, refills and DRAM traffic
official Prosperity product-vs-bit replay as a separately labeled external baseline
real-trace RTL sample miter if a C1 real-trace claim is retained
mandatory_ep29_replays.reason: The current approximately 1.75x C1 number and 51.84M opportunity distribution are checkpoint/workload dependent.

D1 theta payload and numeric miter
D0-D3 address-timed cycles, psum traffic and memory transactions
density and destination/contributor statistics across all frozen sequences
decoder-complete row rather than an exact-subset extrapolation

FC1/FC2 source/event and K-group distributions
ATLIF T10 phase/rank/value-class activity
patch-embed and BN source/commit/traffic counts

mandatory_ep29_replays.reason: Static RTL area can carry; effective cycles, sparsity and energy cannot.

name-mapped SAIF coverage
PTPX dynamic power on retained netlists and static macro leakage/read-write energy
decoder-complete memory-inclusive Table A
same-resource baseline and no multiplication of local speedups

accumulator no-overflow proof on ep29 bounds
INT/CSD/pattern encoding coverage and mismatch count
observed compressed occupancy against retained structural capacity
mandatory_ep29_replays.reason: Physical widths may be invariant, but whether ep29 values safely fit them is not.

mechanical_rebind_manifest.carry_rule: A checkpoint-invariant receipt may be linked to ep29 only when every structural assumption it declares is exactly present in the architecture signature. Any mismatch changes retention from CONDITIONAL to RERUN_OR_RESYNTHESIZE.
mechanical_rebind_manifest.provenance_rule: Every derived row must join on final checkpoint SHA, deployment/config SHA, cohort SHA, generator SHA and simulator/RTL identity. Missing or mixed keys fail closed.
mechanical_rebind_manifest.weight_rule: Weights, exported quantization payloads, compression catalogs, observed occupancy and runtime activity are never mechanically inherited from ep35, ep44 or ep24 by topology equality alone.

nodes.name: freeze ep29 final selection and stable file identity
strict load plus architecture/numeric identity manifest
C1 51.84M four-Conv same-ledger and external artifact replay
decoder bitpack numeric miter and address-cycle replay
ep29 weight export, range proof and compressed-fit check
PTPX with ep29 SAIF on retained netlists
independent replay hammer and final double seal

parallelism: R2A and R2B serialize only if the single A800 cannot host both; load ep29 once and run them back-to-back.
R3A, R3B, R3C and R3D start immediately when R2B seals and run in parallel within the three-worker memory rule.
R4A/R4B use retained netlists and do not wait for a new DC run if R1 proves exact structural identity.
dependency_dag.shortest_path: R0 -> R1 -> R2B -> max(R3A, R3B, R3C, R3D, R4A->R4B), while R2A completes -> R5 -> R6
dependency_dag.estimated_wall_clock_after_ep29_availabl: 8-16 h under no queue/license/tool failure; reserve 24 h operationally. These are scheduling estimates, not measured performance.
dependency_dag.critical_optimization: Capture ordered trace, C1 tensors, decoder bitpacks, ATLIF/FC/attention taps and identity metadata in one instrumented checkpoint session; do not launch one GPU profile per operator.

forbidden_ep24_claim_upgrades: Do not call ep24 the final or selected ep29 checkpoint.
Do not translate epoch24 validation loss into valid825 AEE/AAE or deployment accuracy.
Do not attach C1 1.75x, 51.84M product opportunity, decoder cycles, C2 effective throughput, C3 activity, RQTB compression, or any system speedup to ep24.
Do not inherit ep35 or ep44 activation rates, empty rates, product reuse, attention equality, Amdahl fractions, traffic, SAIF, power or energy into ep29.
Do not publish a decoder-complete or full-system Table A row before E0-E8 join on the ep29 identity.
Do not claim PTPX energy from static DC/PPA; ep29 name-mapped SAIF is mandatory.
Do not infer structural identity from a matching YAML filename; hash and compare the loaded module signature.
Do not treat official Prosperity/Phi replay as our hardware, and do not multiply component ratios.
Do not tune sparsity thresholds or catalogs on valid825 and then reuse valid825 as an independent accuracy gate.
Do not start a full ep24 hardware replay merely to fill time; M1120/M1121 explicitly prohibit it.
